entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme
observations: The 517-aa query has 34.7% identity and 96.5% query coverage to reviewed E. coli Nnr (UniProt P31806; E=1.34e-50); assignment is homology-supported, not direct query-specific experimental evidence.
Reviewed reference Nnr catalyzes NAD(P)HX R/S epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of the S form, restoring NAD(P)H or NADPH; reference annotations include EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136.
Reference reaction: (6S)-NADHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADH + H(+); analogous NADPHX conversion yields NADPH.
Reference annotation reports one bound K+ per subunit; this is homolog-derived and not independently established for the query.
